notes.title: Live Street 2.0 Update
notes.content:
[b]
We have prepared a street renovation for the steam summer sale![/b]

What's new:
1) Fixed bugs
2) Work has been done with spelling
3) New people have been added
4) Added data to phones
5) Now there are more events happening outside the window


Friends! Thanks to everyone who leaves warm reviews, we are happy to read them and listen to your opinions! 
In the future, we plan to add more interesting stories and events, we will be glad if you visit our discord server!

notes.title: Update "Police Wave"
notes.content:
Hello everyone
And here is our next update, in which you will have the opportunity to work for the police

Full list of changes:

* Added a new storyline with the police
* New photos added
* New characters added
* Changed the UI in the phone parsing menu
* Added a new achievement
* Now Decibel worries about parting

notes.title: Small balance update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We have prepared another update, this time it affected the balance
Full list of changes:

*New photos added
*New characters added
*New messages have been added
*Fixed grammatical errors
*Now rich people can give up cheap repairs
*Achievements are now working correctly
*Prices for some spare parts have been changed
*Changed the prices of wishes for a trip to the sea


The next update will be released in about a month. It's going to be a big update with new stories, investigations and endings!

Thank you to the players for supporting the project!

notes.title: Hot update!
notes.content:
We want to express our huge gratitude to the community that supports us, we continue to develop the game and today we have another update!

*Added "hot" data to some girls' phones
*New characters added
*Fixed some grammatical errors
*Added a new ending (losing)


Dear players, we are in search of Lin's character! If you know where she went or have any information, please let us know in Discord!

notes.title: Updating the version
notes.content:
The development of the game continues, we plan to add more new stories and characters! Today we are releasing a small update, a list of changes:

* New data has been added to the phones
* New characters added
* Fixed bugs with calendar and door layers
* Fixed grammatical errors
* A new story has been added
* Added 6 new achievements
* Saving language settings
* Added new character reviews

notes.title: Living Street update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!!!👋😊

Our development team has been hard at work over the past couple of weeks, and we're excited to announce the release of a new update for our favorite game, Living Street! If you haven't tried out the game yet, now is the perfect time to dive into the world of phone repair, which has never been more exciting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417344/db30bb4d8abdb302a0d680dc922389e18b5ea430.png[/img]

Here's a summary of this update, as well as a detailed changelog from our talented programmer:

🖼️ Improved visual experience:
Immerse yourself in a whole new world of visuals with updated window views.
Appreciate the dynamic weather changes that now add realism to the gameplay.

🚀 Get ready for a game-changing experience - now weather directly affects the delivery time of your orders. ⌛ 🌧️🌞

🚗 A changed perspective on the street outside your window:
When analyzing your car selection, assess the customer's financial situation, which will help you set the ideal repair price.

📜 details and improvements:
More beautifully designed pause menu.

💼 Simplified interface:
We've temporarily removed blank windows in your in-game notebook, paving the way for exciting new content that's in development.

🤝 Get ready for exciting new events that will keep you on your guard.

🤖 Improved Smart Assistant:
Your trusted smart assistant is back and provides even more invaluable information to help you through the challenges of phone repair.

With these incredible updates, the game promises to deliver an even more immersive and addictive gameplay experience. 

🔥💼So roll up your sleeves, grab your tools and dive into the colorful world of phone repair!

Thank you for your support.  Happy playing! 📱🛠️🎮
